title: Satoshi's Countdown
one_liner: Race a simulated self-improving AI against SHA-256 to see when it could theoretically crack and drain the original Bitcoin wallet.
headline: Set how fast a fictional AI doubles its compute, toggle quantum-assisted mode, and watch it race across SHA-256's keyspace to "drain" Satoshi's genesis wallet.

episode.title: Chamath: AGI Is Here, Anthropic’s $100B Giveaway, Elon’s SpaceX Shares for 72M Kids | EP #304

history.summary: A tight, honest execution of a risky idea: the disclaimer banner, reality-check panel, and inspectable model-assumptions JSON do real work to prevent misinformation, and the underlying crack-time math is internally consistent (verified the formula reproduces the displayed "~40.1 years" at default settings). Every interactive element in the demo spec — doubling slider, fixed keyspace bar, animated race, classical/quantum toggle — is present and functions correctly on both desktop and mobile with no console errors.
